title: Mid-level Backend Developer
description: Mid-level backend engineer capable of independently designing complex microservices, implementing Hexagonal/DDD patterns, optimizing database queries with EXPLAIN ANALYZE, configuring Kafka/RabbitMQ message pipelines, and managing distributed auth and observability.

skills.rationale: Designing Hexagonal / Clean Architecture boundaries, modeling tactical DDD aggregates, and architecting microservices.
Optimizing queries using EXPLAIN ANALYZE, configuring ACID transaction isolation levels, and working with NoSQL document stores.
Implementing cache-aside/write-through strategies, mitigating cache stampedes, and building RabbitMQ/Kafka producer-consumer workflows.
Designing GraphQL schemas with DataLoader, implementing gRPC Protobuf services, and managing API versioning lifecycles.
Implementing OAuth2 / PKCE authorization code flows, enforcing RBAC/ABAC policies, and managing runtime secrets with Vault.
Implementing Circuit Breakers and Bulkhead resource isolation, managing non-blocking concurrency, and load balancing.
Validating microservice contracts with Pact, load testing p95/p99 latency with k6, and maintaining SonarQube quality gates.
Instrumenting code with OpenTelemetry distributed trace spans, APM slow query profiling, and Sentry error tracking.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is sum divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.label: Not Ready
not_ready.description: Significant gaps in backend architecture, database indexing, or message queueing.

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: Competent with layered APIs, but needs guidance on microservice boundaries, Kafka streaming, and circuit breakers.

approaching.label: Approaching Ready
approaching.description: Strong systems understanding, independent feature delivery, and solid grasp of caching and indexing patterns.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Meets all mid-level expectations: designs robust microservices with Kafka/RabbitMQ, optimized databases, and resilient circuit breakers.

exceeds.label: Exceeds Expectations
exceeds.description: Exceeds mid-level expectations with advanced distributed systems architecture and performance engineering leadership.
